title: Naturally Crunchy Welsh Berries Eton Mess
description: A crunchy and refreshing dessert featuring ground cardamom and yuzu-cure, perfect for warm weather gatherings. This raw-friendly Eton mess is a crowd-pleaser with its herbal notes and crunchy texture.

ingredients.name: fresh mixed berries
ingredients.notes: such as strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the fresh mixed berries, ground cardamom, and yuzu juice until well combined.
In a small bowl, mix together the honey and chopped fresh mint leaves until well combined.
Add the honey and mint mixture to the berry mixture and stir until the honey is fully incorporated.
In a separate bowl, whip the whipped cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold the whipped cream into the berry mixture until no white streaks remain.
Sprinkle the crunchy granola over the top of the berry mixture.
Garnish with additional chopped fresh mint leaves and yuzu zest if desired.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
